title: Tesserae touch-v3 glyph atlas descriptor
description: Describes one text glyph strip the firmware blits. Text-only by default; may also carry named icon glyphs (e.g. @bulb) for devices that use the atlas icon-fallback path.

id.description: Handle referenced by primitive text refs, e.g. l20, v28.

digest.description: Content hash of the strip binary; immutable cache key. Derived from (charset, font, px, weight).

url.description: GET path for the strip binary.

format.description: 4bpp grayscale strip, high nibble = left pixel, 0 = paper .. 15 = full ink.

strip_h.description: Uniform glyph height across the strip.

ascent.description: Baseline offset from top, for vertical centering in a rect.

space_adv.description: Advance width for the space character.

glyphs.description: Map of character (or @icon-name for atlas-icon fallback) to its strip slot.
